newsitem.title: USA: Masco sees Q1 meeting estimates.
newsitem.headline: Masco sees Q1 meeting estimates.

text.p: Masco Corp said Wednesday it expects first quarter earnings to equal or slightly exceed the current analysts' consensus forecast of approximately $0.49 a share, compared to the $0.39 for the 1996 first quarter.

Chairman and Chief Executive Officer Richard A. Manoogian told an investor conference in New York that growth achieved in 1996 in the company's home improvement and building products businesses is continuing in early 1997.
Based on present economic trends, Manoogian said the firm believes it will achieve record sales and earnings in its home improvement and building products businesses for all of 1997.
Masco's brands include Delta and Peerless faucets, Merillat, KraftMaid and StarMark cabinetry, Brass Craft and Plumb Shop plumbing specialties, and Baldwin hardware.
